description: This file is a Java source code that implements an Android Activity called MmsMessagingDemo. It provides a UI for sending and receiving MMS messages using the Android framework and MMS library, including functionality for sending messages, downloading messages from a URL, and processing the message data. It also handles MMS send/receive broadcasts and manages related UI updates.

classes.name: MmsMessagingDemo
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates MMS messaging functionality, including sending, receiving, and downloading MMS messages.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, registers broadcast receivers, and handles intents related to MMS notifications.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Constructs a MMS message PDU and initiates the sending process via SmsManager.

methods.name: downloadMessage
methods.description: Starts the process of downloading an MMS message from a URL.

methods.name: handleSentResult
methods.description: Handles the result after attempting to send an MMS message, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleReceivedResult
methods.description: Processes a received MMS message, saving it locally and updating UI with message details.

methods.name: buildPdu
methods.description: Builds a SendReq PDU object containing message details such as recipients, subject, and text.

methods.name: addTextPart
methods.description: Adds a text part and optional SMIL part to the PduBody for MMS.

methods.name: addSmilPart
methods.description: Adds a SMIL part to the PduBody for multimedia presentation in MMS.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Extracts recipient addresses from a retrieved MMS message.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Extracts the subject from a retrieved MMS message.

methods.name: getMessageText
methods.description: Extracts the message text from a retrieved MMS message.

methods.name: getSimNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the device's SIM phone number.
